extraction_notes: Extracted measured ammonia-synthesis performance entries from SI tables and readable time-course figures. Estimated rates in SI Table 1 (r^E_NH3) were not extracted. Duplicate rows across SI Tables 1–4 were consolidated, except where a table provided a distinct condition or catalyst. Characterisation-only figures were excluded.
